title: api-contract-validator
offersHint: Cloudflare Workers MCP server: api-contract-validator · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lazy-mac.com/api-contract-validator/mcp

toolsPreview.name: validate_openapi_spec
toolsPreview.description: Validate an OpenAPI 3.x or AsyncAPI spec JSON. Returns structural errors, missing required fields, and warnings.

toolsPreview.name: diff_request_response
toolsPreview.description: Compare a real HTTP request/response against an OpenAPI spec contract. Returns per-field violations.

toolsPreview.name: lint_api_schema
toolsPreview.description: Lint an API spec for quality and best practice compliance. Rules: operation-id-kebab-case, response-success-required, tags-defined, no-empty-description, security-defined.

toolsPreview.name: generate_mock_from_spec
toolsPreview.description: Generate mock response data from an OpenAPI spec. Uses examples, defaults, formats, and type heuristics.

toolsPreview.name: check_breaking_changes
toolsPreview.description: Compare two OpenAPI spec versions to detect breaking changes: removed paths/operations, new required parameters, removed response codes, operationId renames.
